## The problem

What are you trying to do that the app makes hard today? This project is
focused on writing markdown for AI (CLAUDE.md, skills, prompts, agent notes);
requests that sharpen that use case are the easiest to accept.

## The idea

What you would like the app to do.

## Alternatives

Other ways you have considered solving this, including plugins or other editors
that do it well.

## Anything else

Mockups, references, or context.
